text:
My journey to develop AGI spans 25 yrs, including 10+ yrs thinking about technical & societal perspectives at Google DeepMind. 
AGI is on the horizon - we need deeper understanding of its implications. To help, we've created the DeepMind Institute. https://x.com/i/article/2100217797129240576
